data.name: 我才不会被女孩子欺负呢
data.detailed_description:
Game Introduction

This Is Not Your Typical "Harem Picker" Game
You are Ye Lin, self-proclaimed "Lone Wolf" and the (seemingly) toughest delinquent in school.
You have only one life goal: take revenge on the nightmare of your childhood—that "Little Tyrant" who used to stomp all over you.
But when you finally roll up your sleeves, ready for the ultimate showdown—
That childhood nightmare now stands before you... transformed into a sweet, soft girl who wants to be your girlfriend?
Is this a trap? A conspiracy? Or… damn it, is this love?

Your Youth Is a Battle Called "Not Getting Bullied by Girls"
In the city of "Winter Hill," your opponents aren’t just ghosts from the past. As the protagonist Ye Lin, you’ll be caught in the whirlpools of five uniquely "troublesome" girls. Every choice you make decides whether you’ll be completely wrapped around their fingers—or turn the tables and take charge:

·       Face the "Little Tyrant," Ren Xiaoqin: Toggle between her dual personalities. Will you expose her gentle facade, or lose yourself in her… yandere tenderness?

·       Challenge the "Moral Enforcer," Shu Sha: The class monitor and discipline committee queen—she’s the embodiment of order. Will you survive under her watch, or try to melt this icy heart?

·       Serve the "Spoiled Heiress," Amy: A mixed-race young lady who’s rich, utterly capricious, and not much else. Will you resign to being her servant, or teach her a thing or two about "commoner’s wisdom"?

·       Protect the "Clueless Committee Member," Gong Caicai: She is like an angel with a devil's body — a breathtaking contrast that makes her both irresistibly adorable and dangerously alluring, yet she remains as timid as a mouse.

·       PK the "Energetic Fighter," Xiong Yaoyue: The undefeated queen of the arcade, and your best "bro." When the line between buddy-ship and something more starts to blur… can you still see her as just a gaming pal?

Game Features:

1. Rich and interesting plot : Players' choices will affect the favorability between characters and the direction of the plot, providing up to 12 different endings.

2. Deep Character Interaction: In-depth dialogue and interaction with each character unlocks more stories behind them.

3. Achievement system: Contains bronze, silver, gold, and platinum cups to motivate players to explore every corner of the game.

4. High freedom of city map and scene exploration: Players can freely explore Dongshan City, visit different venues, and trigger unique events.

Follow Us

Welcome to follow us for the latest updates on the game I Won’t Be Bullied by Girls!

Official Bilibili account: Lingdong Comic Studio

In the game, players will experience the stories and interactions between several girls from the first person perspective of the male protagonist, promote the development of the plot, and explore the city map.

content_descriptors.notes:
The discussion of adult content topics, textual descriptions and displays of adult products, intimate actions, and more revealing dressing scenes in the game may not be suitable for everyone. There are mild combat scenes and action graphics in the game, which may not be suitable for players who are not accustomed to action manipulation.

This game contains content that is not appropriate for all ages and may be considered offensive or disturbing.

References to Sexual Content and Violence:
The game includes discussions related to sexual conduct but does not depict explicit sexual acts or imagery. There are action-based fights between characters, limited to common brawls without extreme gore or graphic violence. Some underage characters may briefly suggest sexually provocative poses, but no direct nudity is shown.

Potentially Sensitive Topics:
The game contains mild, humorously intended references to "sexual harassment," such as a scene in Chapter 1 where the male protagonist is harassed by a female passenger on a subway. These topics are presented through dialogue and narrative only, with no visual depiction or explicit description of the acts themselves.
